messages:
Marina S: Heads up — our latest JS SDK publish changed the package exports and it's breaking a handful of edge runtime sample apps (Vercel Edge / Cloudflare Workers). Repro attached below.

Kevin W: Ugh, thanks for flagging. What's the symptom? bundle fails at runtime or TS compile errors?

Marina S: Runtime crash on import for some apps: `Uncaught TypeError: require is not a function` in the entry bundle when running on Vercel Edge. Local Node (CJS) is fine. We also saw TypeScript not resolving types for the new export map (no index.d.ts found).

Samir P: Can you paste your import and package.json snippets? Might be export map ordering/fields.

Marina S: Sure — simple import: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'`

Marina S: package.json in the app that's failing:
```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/inference-js": "^1.3.0"
  }
}
```

Marina S: And the SDK's package.json (from npm) has an `exports` like: 
```json
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
}
```

Diana L: That exports shape looks wrong — `exports` should map entrypoints, not top-level keys like `import`/`require` under the root object. Node matches conditions by path. Many bundlers/edge resolvers choke on ambiguous export maps.

Kevin W: Right — when `exports` isn't shaped as "." : {"import":..., "require":...}, some resolvers ignore it and fall back to `main` or do weird resolution that ends up requiring CJS in an ESM-only environment.

Samir P: Also TS needs either `types` or "types" export mapping so `tsc`/IDE can find `.d.ts`. If the SDK only exposes `types` through `package.json` top-level `types` but not in `exports`, some tooling won't pick it up with the export map present.

Marina S: Observed behavior summary:
- Vercel Edge: runtime throws `require is not a function` because bundler included CJS shim or resolved to cjs entry.
- Cloudflare: build fails with resolver error `No matching export found for "./dist/index.mjs"` on some versions.
- TS: editor shows `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference-js'` when project has `"moduleResolution": "bundler"` or `node16`.

ci-bot: Repro tests queued — 3 failing builds (edge-sample-apps) — see CI run 9821.

Diana L: Short-term workaround: publish a small compat entrypoint (add `"./edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"` in exports) or expose `"."` mapping. Consumers can `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js/edge'` until we fix upstream. Also add `"types"` inside the `"."` exports so TS picks it up: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./edge": {
    "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

Kevin W: Agree. Longer-term we should: 1) follow Node export map patterns (dot entrypoint), 2) ship `types` inside exports, 3) add a Vite/ESBuild compat note in changelog, 4) update the SDK sample apps to import the explicit edge path in the README.

Samir P: There's also an auth/retry subtlety I noticed: our ESM build switched token refresh to a dynamic `require()` in one helper file. On edge runtimes `require` isn't available so token refresh silently fails causing 401 loops and spurious retries. We need to remove dynamic requires or use import() or a pure ESM path.

Marina S: Yep — that explains the 401 loops we've seen in logs. Example stack trace from Cloudflare logs: `TypeError: require is not a function at refreshToken (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/token-helper.mjs:45:12)`

Diana L: Good catch. Putting token refresh into a tiny ESM-only module would fix it. Also add a smoke test in the edge-sample-apps CI that runs in a real edge env to catch this before release.

Kevin W: I'll open a patch PR to revert the incorrect `exports` shape and add types mapping + edge entry. Samir, can you open a small PR to remove the require from token-helper (or provide an ESM branch)? Marina, can you add the failing sample repo as an integration test in CI?

Samir P: On it — will submit PRs against `canary` and tag the releases team.

Marina S: Added a tiny repro repo link in the CI ticket: https://github.com/redwood-internal/edge-repro-9821 (private). It reproduces on Vercel Edge and Cloudflare.

ci-bot: PR smoke tests scheduled.

Diana L: After patch we should publish a patch release and include a migration note: "If you hit require is not a function on edge, pin to @redwood/inference-js@1.2.x and upgrade after applying the fix."

Marina S: Thanks all — moving the failing sample into a protected branch so CI won't spam main. Ping me if you need repro creds. :thumbsup:

Kevin W: Will coordinate the release. I'll also add a devex doc for `exports` gotchas (bundlers + TS + edge).
